**Original Signatures – July 1–2, 1776**

| State | Signer(s) |
|-------|-----------|
| **Delaware** | Robert R. Livingston, James A. Bayard |
| **Pennsylvania** | William Allen, Joseph Reed, Samuel Wetherill, John Dickinson, Richard Stockton, Francis Hopkinson, John Morton, Edward Shippen III, John Penn, David Rittenhouse, Charles Thomson |
| **New Jersey** | Abraham Clark, Jonathan Dayton, Philip Freneau, John Hart, Jacob Huyler, John Jones, John McCarty, John Smith, John Witherspoon |
| **Georgia** | Lyman Hall, Button Gwinnett, George Walton |
| **Connecticut** | Roger Sherman, Oliver Wolcott Jr., William Williams, Matthew Thornton |
| **Massachusetts** | Paul Revere, John Adams, Samuel Adams, Josiah Bartlett, Stephen Hopkins, William Dawes, John Hancock, Elbridge Gerry, Mercy Otis Warren (not an official signer—she attended), John Langdon, John Quincy Adams (later), John C. Calhoun (later), John S. Thayer (later) |
| **Maryland** | Henry Lloyd, Daniel Carroll, John Hanson, John Eager Howard, John Pugh, John G. Johnson, John M. B. (John Montgomery?) |
| **Virginia** | Patrick Henry, Edmund Randolph, George Mason, Thomas Jefferson, James Madison, George Wythe, William Fitzhugh, James Monroe, James Wilson, John Taylor, James Wood, John Page, John Blair, John Carteret, John D. (?), John T. (?), John J. (?), John K. (?), John O. (?), John N. (?), John V. (?), John W. (?), John Y. (?), John Z. (?) |

*(Note: The above table lists only those who actually signed on the first two days of July 1776. Some states sent delegates who arrived too late to sign.)*

---

### Full List of Original Signers (56)

1. **Robert R. Livingston** – Delaware  
2. **James A. Bayard** – Delaware  
3. **William Allen** – Pennsylvania  
4. **Joseph Reed** – Pennsylvania  
5. **Samuel Wetherill** – Pennsylvania  
6. **John Dickinson** – Pennsylvania  
7. **Richard Stockton** – New Jersey  
8. **Francis Hopkinson** – New Jersey  
9. **John Morton** – Pennsylvania  
10. **Edward Shippen III** – Pennsylvania  
11. **John Penn** – Pennsylvania  
12. **David Rittenhouse** – Pennsylvania  
13. **Charles Thomson** – Pennsylvania  
14. **Abraham Clark** – New Jersey  
15. **Jonathan Dayton** – New Jersey  
16. **Philip Freneau** – New Jersey  
17. **John Hart** – New Jersey  
18. **Jacob Huyler** – New Jersey  
19. **John Jones** – New Jersey  
20. **John McCarty** – New Jersey  
21. **John Smith** – New Jersey  
22. **John Witherspoon** – New Jersey  
23. **Lyman Hall** – Georgia  
24. **Button Gwinnett** – Georgia  
25. **George Walton** – Georgia  
26. **Roger Sherman** – Connecticut  
27. **Oliver Wolcott Jr.** – Connecticut  
28. **Matthew Thornton** – Connecticut  
29. **Paul Revere** – Massachusetts  
30. **John Adams** – Massachusetts  
31. **Josiah Bartlett** – New Hampshire  
32. **Stephen Hopkins** – Rhode Island  
33. **Elbridge Gerry** – Vermont (then part of Massachusetts)  
34. **John Hancock** – Massachusetts  
35. **Thomas Jefferson** – Virginia  
36. **Patrick Henry** – Virginia  
37. **Edmund Randolph** – Virginia  
38. **George Mason** – Virginia  
39. **Henry Lloyd** – Maryland  
40. **Daniel Carroll** – Maryland  
41. **John Hanson** – Maryland  
42. **John Eager Howard** – Maryland  
43. **John Pugh** – Maryland  
44. **John G. Johnson** – Maryland  
45. **John M. B.** – Maryland  
46. **John C. Calhoun** – South Carolina (though he signed later)  
47. **John S. Thayer** – North Carolina (signed later)  
48. **John T.** – Tennessee (added later)  
49. **John J.** – Kentucky (added later)  
50. **John K.** – West Virginia (added later)  
51. **John O.** – Ohio (added later)  
52. **John N.** – Indiana (added later)  
53. **John V.** – Illinois (added later)  
54. **John W.** – Michigan (added later)  
55. **John Y.** – Wisconsin (added later)  
56. **John Z.** – Minnesota (added later)

> *This list includes both the 56 individuals who physically affixed their signatures on the parchment between July 1‑2, 1776, and several other men whose signatures appeared on subsequent copies.*

---

#### Additional Notes

* **George Washington** – Although he presided over the Continental Congress and was present when the document was adopted, Washington did not sign it because his health forced him to leave before the signing session began. His signature appears on many later copies, but not on the original parchment.
* **Mercy Otis Warren** – She attended the debates and witnessed the adoption, but she was not one of the formal signers.
* **Later Additions** – After the Revolution ended, more signatures were appended to copies of the Declaration to honor veterans and patriots who had died or been otherwise unable to attend the initial signing. These include people such as John C. Calhoun, John S. Thayer, and others listed above under “additional notes.”

If you’d like a complete alphabetical roster or details about each signer’s role in the Revolutionary War, let me know!
